No strike confirmed as of 25 Oct 17:35 TRT. Alert only if an actual strike/escalation happens. 25 Oct ~18:00 TRT: Fars (citing OSINT) reports explosion in Hormuz from anti-ship cruise missile launch; single-source, no confirmed hit. CBS 19:11 TRT: still no strike, Araghchi defiant. ~19:26 TRT: Trump 'there will not be a strike today'.

Ongoing conflict; alert if major oil facility damage confirmed or Hormuz/Red Sea shipping shut. 25 Oct: more interceptions (Riyadh, Khamis Mushait, 10 BMs south, debris Mecca prov.), Houthis claim Yanbu Aramco targeted, no confirmed damage; Riyadh airport reopened.
Zelensky open to freezing front lines, no territorial concessions; routine strikes ongoing.
~410k protesters, 1,000+ arrests in France on 24 Oct.
Karak church terror attack, death toll 9.
